_note: Per-case display metadata for uptake-report (domain, type, English glosses). Detection rules never read this table; it only labels the report. English titles/outcomes are editor glosses of the case record, kept here as data so report code embeds no case names or quoted phrases.

avianca052.title_en: Avianca 052 — fuel emergency misread on approach to JFK
avianca052.outcome_en: Ran out of fuel and crashed at Cove Neck; 73 of 158 aboard died. The word 'emergency' was never spoken to ATC.

airflorida90.title_en: Air Florida 90 — icing warnings softened in the cockpit
airflorida90.outcome_en: Took off with ice on the wings and hit the 14th Street Bridge; 78 died. The first officer hinted at wrong readings four times.

tenerife1977.title_en: Tenerife 1977 — 'takeoff' heard as position, not action
tenerife1977.outcome_en: KLM 747 began its takeoff roll without clearance and collided with the Pan Am 747 on the runway; 583 died.

lear_1_1.title_en: King Lear 1.1 — 'Nothing, my lord' heard as defiance
lear_1_1.outcome_en: Lear reads Cordelia's 'Nothing' as loveless disobedience, disinherits her and banishes Kent. The tragedy's starting point.

usair1549.title_en: US Airways 1549 — short words that landed everyone safely
usair1549.outcome_en: Both engines lost; ditched in the Hudson with all 155 surviving. Brief, plain words met with options from ATC.

sejong_1444.title_en: Sejong 1444 — a policy protest argued, not punished
sejong_1444.outcome_en: Sejong answered the anti-Hangul memorial point by point, jailed the memorialists for a day and freed them. Dissent handled as debate.

reykjavik1986.outcome_en: Close to a strategic-arms deal, the summit broke over SDI testing confined to the 'laboratory'; led to the INF treaty a year later.

aci_D2N068.title_en: Mock clinic visit (ACI-Bench D2N068) — did the plan land?
aci_D2N068.outcome_en: Simulated visit (not a real patient): where the treatment plan did or did not get across.
